description: Record the run from where it is as an MP4 movie (H.264), stepping it as it goes: the current view with a color bar, x/y/z axes and the status line (grid, simulation time) over it. A frame every `every` steps, or near every `dt` of code time (at the nearest step boundary: no step is shortened, so the run is the one it would have been unrecorded). Stops at `until`, after `frames` frames, or at the end time. Set the view first. Returns the frame count, movie length and where the file went.

bitrate_mbps.description: Megabits per second of movie (default 0.2 bits per pixel per frame: 25 at 1080p and 60 fps)

dt.description: A frame near every multiple of this much code time (default: a 600th of the dynamical time of the problem, so one dynamical time plays in 10 s at 60 fps)

every.description: Or a frame every this many steps

height.description: Default 1080 (9/16 of width when width is given)

path.description: File or folder to write to (default: the current folder, under the name of the movie)

status.description: The status line (grid, simulation time, point masses, mesh). Default true

timeout_s.description: Give up after this much wall time, keeping what was recorded

until.description: Stop when the clock reaches this time (landed on exactly)

name: record
